messages.subject: Quantifying number of spatial recapture
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

Is it possible to obtain the number of spatial recaptures from the capture history object? So far we haven't found this piece of information from the summary(capthist) function or in the raw output of the capthist object but I wonder if we've somehow overlooked it.

Thanks for any insights!

Jennifer

messages.subject: Re: Quantifying number of spatial recapture
messages.body_plain:
Depends what you mean by "spatial recaptures", but assuming you want the number of detections at distance >0 from the preceding one then
sum(unlist(moves(captdata))>0)
... noting that this is depends on an arbitrary ordering of detections within an occasion for 'proximity' and 'count' detectors (we don't actually record the temporal sequence of within-occasion 'recaptures').
Murray
